From Surface · Price: the target mirrors the puppet's moves only while it can see the puppet.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 10 minutes: carve a puppet copy of a creature you've touched.
  • 5: Surge: the puppet takes 1 action (Stride, Strike, drop an item or drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone}) and the target must copy it on its next action (@Check[will|against:stand|traits:incapacitation]{Will}, incapacitation).
  • 9: The puppet can Impersonate the target.
  • 13: The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} to the puppet.
  • 17: The target mirrors two actions.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
